replace: for (const arm of arms) for (let round = 1; round <= runs; round++) order.push({ round, arm });
why: Runs are taken arm by arm instead of round by round, so any drift over the sitting (a runner warming, a noisy neighbour) lands on whichever arm runs last and reads as that arm's cost.
killedBy: the benchmark runner (issue #738) interleaves the arms round by round, so drift over the sitting lands on every arm
